name: second-brain-os
title_zh: 在 Obsidian 里自己整理自己的第二大脑
tagline_zh: 笔记越写越乱、标签越加越多的时候，它按一套固定流程把新笔记归位、补链、更新索引，你只负责往里丢。
tagline_en: When your notes pile up faster than you can file them, this runs a fixed routine to sort, link and re-index each.
desc_en: An AI second brain that maintains itself. Full guide, starter vault, agent skills and scripts for a self-organizing knowledge base in Claude Code and Obsidian.
why_zh: 整理规则写在技能和脚本里，不是靠你每次重新描述一遍；同一套流程反复跑，结构不会随心情漂移。
why_en: The filing rules live in skills and scripts, not in your prompt each time. Same routine every run, so the structure doesn't.
limit_zh: 要同时装 Obsidian 和 Claude Code，缺一个就只能读文档；只覆盖纯文本 Markdown 笔记。
limit_en: Needs both Obsidian and Claude Code; missing either leaves you with docs only. Markdown text notes only — no PDFs, clippings or images. It edits.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A second brain in Obsidian that files itself
